Assuming MHP purchase at 75% contained nickel value 16 # **Summary** - Nickel laterite resource owners have multiple options - Direct shipping ore, low capital cost but low product value, especially for low grade ore - MHP production, reasonable capital cost but low product value (7075%) - Metal production by SX or FeNi, very high capital cost but high product value (100%) - MHP is a popular option, but low payable makes it uneconomic at low nickel prices - High value products are key to being economic at low nickel prices - But, need a low capital and operating cost to get shareholder return 17 # **Thank you** - Metallica Minerals Ltd, BHP Billiton Nickel West, First Quantum Minerals Ltd, Highlands Pacific Ltd, Teck Resources Ltd, Queensland Nickel - Boyd Willis, David White, Chad Czerny 18
